profile.headline: Software Engineer/Site Reliability Engineer at Google

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description:
- Collaborated with clients to identify their problem and develop alternative
architectures to meet their needs
- Developed a locally run simulation of the client’s ETL pipeline using Python,
Redis, Aerospike, HDFS, Spark, and Docker
- Presented client’s current system as a case study to Avalon engineers,
and demonstrated the scaled down simulation
- Investigated applications and viability of Aerospike as a database,
and compiled the information for employee knowledge base

positions.title: Software Engineering Coop
positions.description:
- Developed a scripting interface to record user actions and generate a JavaScript
file that would perform the same actions, testing integration with customer software
- Created a method for including guided tutorials to the SDK by replacing a JSON file
- Wrote example code for customers illustrating how to communicate with the aircraft’s
flight management system (MFMS) via Ethernet

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description:
- Developed tools for generating images from camera footage used to train object detectors
- Implemented an automated training program that optimized the variables in an SVM-based object detector for a given image set
- Automated the process of optimizing a cascade-based classifier to reduce human interaction

positions.title: Team Member
positions.description:
- My team assembled 480 to 520 car doors a day.
- Worked on a team of 20.
- Utilized poka-yokes to ensure torques on critical joints (airbag sensors).
- Gained experience with lean manufacturing, Kaizen, and JIT.

positions.title: Courtesy Clerk Front End
positions.description:
- Bagged groceries
- Assisted elderly and handicapped customers with their groceries
- Returned items not purchased to shelves
- Gathered carts

positions.title: Exemplar Scholars Research Project
positions.description:
- Worked with retired IBM engineer Phil Heink 
- Programmed software using C and OpenCV libraries
- Developed a program that enhances surface detail on worn inscriptions using a video camera and a horizontal laser line
